statement: TSMC announced an incremental $100 billion U.S. investment linked to the U.S.-Taiwan trade and investment deal announced in January 2026.
why: Additional leading-edge capacity from the dominant foundry, sited in the United States, changes both how much accelerator supply exists and where geopolitical risk sits.

impact.mechanism: Incremental foundry capital expands future leading-edge wafer and packaging capacity for AI silicon and diversifies its geographic concentration.

evidence.excerpt: TSMC announced an incremental $100 billion U.S. investment

confidence.basis: Headline investment figure relayed by one secondary aggregator with no timeline, node mix, or capacity detail; effect on accelerator supply is multi-year.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 1 -> 2; sources: OriginBrief - Semiconductor & Chip Industry Weekly
